packageRules.description: Pin PEP 735 groups, which :pinDevDependencies misses. Within a range, uv locks the newest release rather than the one Renovate targeted, and Renovate rejects the result
Update uv and uv_build together: uv builds with its bundled uv_build only while the build-system range admits uv's own version
A pull request held for review picks up main's fixes only by rebasing. A matching package rule from an extended preset overrides a top-level rebaseWhen

customManagers.description: Read `# renovate:` annotations above *_VERSION pins in dev container setup scripts
